newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Xinhua to list internet unit in the U.S. - paper.
newsitem.headline: Xinhua to list internet unit in the U.S. - paper.

text.p: Chinese Internet Corp (CIC), controlled by China's state Xinhua news agency, is expected to appoint Merrill Lynch as sponsor for its plan to seek a U.S. listing, the Hong Kong Economic Journal reported on Thursday.
The newspaper quoted market sources as saying CIC plans to seek a listing on the NASDAQ in New York.
The report gave no further details of the listing.
CIC provides internet access services to users in China, the report said.
A Merrill Lynch official declined to comment on the report and Xinhua officials were unavailable for comment.
Xinhua is also China's de facto consulate in Hong Kong.
